steps.title: Gather equipment and reagents
steps.instruction: Ensure all equipment and reagents listed in the key resources table are available, verify that cell lines are ready for harvesting, and have the stock‑solution list prepared. On the day of nuclei extraction, make all buffers and cool any required equipment before use.

steps.title: Grow cultures to log phase
steps.instruction: Cultivate Chlamydomonas reinhardtii cells (any strain) to log phase, aiming for a density of 1–5 × 10⁶ cells·mL⁻¹ (the protocol used CC‑124 and CC‑5390 at 1–1.5 × 10⁶ cells·mL⁻¹) in TAP or HS medium as appropriate. Harvest only after cultures have reached log‑phase density. Timing: 3–4 days.

steps.title: Prepare fourteen stock solutions
steps.instruction: Follow the instructions in the Materials and Equipment section to prepare all 14 stock solutions, using nuclease‑free water for every preparation.

steps.title: Sterilize stock solutions and media
steps.instruction: Autoclave all stock solutions except 80 % ethanol, 100 mM spermidine, and 1 M DTT; store the autoclaved solutions at room temperature. Sterilize the 100 mM spermidine and 1 M DTT solutions by filtering through a 0.22 μm syringe filter and store them at ‑20 °C. Autoclave TAP and HS media, pipette tips, and the required number of spatulas and funnels. Note: 80 % ethanol does not need sterilization. Timing: ~6 h.

substeps.instruction: Autoclave stock solutions (except ethanol, spermidine, DTT) and store at room temperature.
Filter spermidine (100 mM) and DTT (1 M) through a 0.22 μm syringe filter; store at ‑20 °C.
Autoclave TAP and HS media, pipette tips, spatulas, and funnels.

steps.title: Prepare fresh buffers
steps.instruction: On the day of nuclei extraction, prepare all buffers fresh according to the recipes in the Materials and Equipment section. Sterilize each buffer by passing it through a 0.22 μm syringe filter. Timing: ~1.5 h.

steps.title: Pre‑chill consumables
steps.instruction: Pre‑chill 1 mL pipette tips, spatulas, and funnels on ice while they remain in their autoclaved bags or containers before use.
